description: This Java class defines a scheduled task, AutoCloseVisitsTask, which automatically closes all unvoided active visits matching certain criteria. It extends AbstractTask and implements the execute() method to perform the closing operation, utilizing OpenMRS services.

classes.name: AutoCloseVisitsTask
classes.description: A scheduled task that automatically closes unvoided active visits based on configured visit types.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides the execute method to trigger the auto-close logic, which calls the visit service to stop visits from the current date.
